name: Trustees
overview: The Scriptures emphasize the importance of placing complete trust in the LORD rather than in worldly things or our own understanding. Believers are called to commit their ways to God, trusting that He will accomplish His purposes on their behalf. Trusting in God provides security and courage, especially in times of fear, contrasting with the unreliability of human strength or resources. The concept of trusteeship also involves faithfulness in what is entrusted to us, as highlighted by the call to honesty and integrity in handling what has been committed to our care.
